scenarios.description: Reputation functions: AddReputation and RemoveReputation per deed size (1-5) on both axes of two reputations with different scales, SetReputation edges (negative, above the scale, fractional, sizes 0 and 6), and GetReputation, GetReputationPct and GetReputationThreshold (mixed/good/bad) over a fame x infamy grid at the level boundaries (0.15, 0.5 and 1 x the REPU's DATA value). In-game capture on save nvfdoc. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest3_reputation.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 3 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4, 8 and 9); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

Effect scripts of aid items: ScriptEffectStart has run when EquipItem returns (Nuka-Cola's cap, Cateye's Nighteye, Contreras' supplies restoring a limb); a duration-0 effect restores nothing after the use; an ability's ScriptEffectUpdate restores ScriptEffectElapsedSeconds / 10 health per frame (changes per frame and the rate per second of script time). In-game capture on save nvfdoc. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest3_effect_start.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 3 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4, 8 and 9); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

Effect script duration: seconds of script time (GetSecondsPassed) from using a Cateye to its ScriptEffectFinish (Nighteye back to 0), without and with a container menu held open during the effect, and with a second Cateye taken while the first is active (one Finish or two). In-game capture on save nvfdoc. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest3_effect_duration.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 3 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4, 8 and 9); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.

Order of quest and object scripts within one frame: BeatrixFX's GameMode adds an hour to GameHour; two Goodsprings windows (WastelandWindowScript) copy GetCurrentTime into a variable in their GameMode every frame; the lag, in frames, between GameHour's jump and the windows' variables (0: the object scripts ran after the quest script in that frame). In-game capture on save nvftest. Input parity-lab/inputs/layer5/quest3_script_order.actions.json (fnv.script.actions/1 with the round 3 additions, docs/spec-notes/layer5-captures.md sections 4, 8 and 9); fnvtool script run errors on the additions until workstream 5B implements them.
